grain_definition: one row = one (date_jst, mall, campaign_id, ad_type, target, target_granularity)
clear_strategy_detail: First chunk of run includes meta.clear_amazon_ads_sku_dates=[<all dates in scope, including 0-row dates>] for Render side to DELETE before insert. Ads attribution restates past days, so full-scope clear removes stale rows.
apply_mode_detail: INSERT OR REPLACE on (date_jst, mall, campaign_id, ad_type, target, target_granularity). source_run_id / source_row_hash track origin
notes: amazon-dashboard PR-A (2026-07-06) で導入。spAdvertisedProduct 由来の SKU/ASIN 別広告費。target は LOWER 済み (fetch-amazon-ads.js が正規化)。Auto-Targeting の未配賦分は amazon_ads_campaign_daily との差分で導出する。日本語列 (fact_ad_spend) → 英語キー (payload/mirror) の mapping は sync-amazon-ads-daily.js の SELECT で実施
